question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Knowing** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence requires a verb that fits with the preposition "to" in the following phrase "to fill in blank number 1". • "Knowing" is the only option that makes sense grammatically in this context. • **Knowing **the present participle (-ing) form of the verb '**know**' which means having information, understanding, or awareness about a particular subject or fact. (किसी विशेष विषय या तथ्य के बारे में जानकारी, समझ या जागरूकता होना) • **Example**: Knowing the importance of time management, she efficiently planned her schedule to balance work and personal commitments. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Regarding: **In reference to or concerning. (सन्दर्भ में या विषय में) • **Attempting: **Making an effort or trying to accomplish a task. (किसी कार्य को पूरा करने के लिए प्रयास करना या प्रयास करना) • **Before: **Prior to or earlier than a specified time or event. (किसी निर्दिष्ट समय या घटना से पहले) 49:T9b2, The correct answer is: **Injured**
